description:
[Step 3 of find_a_clinician]

Returns open appointment times for one clinician and service, grouped by day and labelled in the family's state time zone. Each time carries the date_time value that get_booking_link takes.

Use when: A family has chosen a clinician and wants to see open times.

Don't use when: No clinician is chosen yet: search_providers or recommend_care find one.

Example: get_availability({ state: 'Texas', service: 'adhd-testing', provider_id: '7598079' })

provider_id.description: Clinician id from search_providers or recommend_care.

service.description: therapy (the default), clinical-matching (unsure what is needed), medication (non-stimulant only), adhd-testing or autism-testing.

state.description: U.S. state, full name or 2-letter code. For a state Emora does not serve, the result says so and lists alternatives.

time_zone.description: Optional IANA time zone, e.g. 'America/Chicago'. Defaults to the state's main zone.

name: get_availability
title: Get a clinician's availability
